description.value: A provincial government-operated retail liquor outlet, part of the 198-store BCLIQUOR chain, known locally as the Kensington location. It stocks an extensive range of wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders from BC and around the world. For touring cyclists passing through North Vancouver, it is a convenient stop to resupply with beverages.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website page title identifies this specific store as 'KENSINGTON,' not 'BC Liquor Store' as recorded in OSM — a minor name discrepancy worth flagging. The website content is the generic BCLIQUOR chain site and provides no store-specific detail on bike parking, washrooms, or water refill; all required and optional amenity fields must be null. The OSM record was checked as recently as 2026-05-10 and looks_closed is false, so the store is confirmed active.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the name as 'BC Liquor Store' but the website page title identifies this specific location as 'KENSINGTON.' The OSM name may be the brand rather than the store's own name.
The website URL resolves to a generic store-locator page with no store-specific amenity detail; no required or optional cyclist amenities could be confirmed.
Store phone number (+1-604-660-0322) appears only in OSM; the website shows only head-office and customer-service numbers, so the store-level number cannot be confirmed or contradicted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate beverage supply stop for touring cyclists, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to determine whether it meets minimum directory standards.
